panel-en.about: This is a platform for nutritionists. In one place you manage clients, build meal plans, schedule appointments and bill for your service. Every client gets an app on their phone, under your name.
panel-en.intro: In the next two minutes you will see three things: how clients are managed, how a meal plan is built, and how you get paid.
panel-en.clients: The client list shows who is active and how long access is paid for.
panel-en.plan: A meal plan is a table of days and meals. Each meal can be replaced, removed, or added.
panel-en.invoices: You issue invoices from the panel. The client sees them in the app.
panel-en.outro: To recap. You have seen how clients are managed, how a meal plan is built, and how invoices work. Thank you for watching.
